title: Five Flats, Three Borders - rent 146,000 GBP - LOCAL WORKING COPY
jurisdiction: England and Wales; People's Republic of China; Liechtenstein
role: Lead cross-border adviser coordinating UK, PRC and Liechtenstein specialists
premise: A PRC tax resident who is not UK resident proposes to acquire one fictional English property containing exactly five self-contained flats for third-party residential letting. The client prefers a Liechtenstein fund and seeks a 10% annual return, while residence, beneficial ownership, source of wealth, source and route of funds, purchaser identity, financing terms, regulatory availability, and tax treatment require evidence.

taxTopics: UK disposal and inheritance tax exposure
UK–China treaty and foreign tax credits

taxEconomics.assumptions:
Tax base is prefilled as gross annual rent less rental-property expenses less annual loan-interest expense. Verify every case input and tax rate before relying on the estimate.
Tax-rate sources: baseline=unset; optimized=unset.

assumptions: The acquisition-cost input is 7% of the £1,000,000 price and is provisional rather than a calculated SDLT amount.

Owner-revised annual gross rent: £146,000. Expenses: 25% × £146,000 = £36,500/year. Rent after these expenses: £109,500/year before financing and other costs. After £10,000 structure cost and £113,953.70 amortizing debt service, cash flow is −£14,453.70/year before tax and unknown costs. Independent evidence and outcome approval are pending.
Known initial cash is at least £285,000 before currently unpriced professional, lender, valuation, registration, and reserve costs.
Scheduled amortizing debt service uses the supplied control of £9,496.14 monthly and £113,953.70 annually, subject to confirmation.
The lender's minimum DSCR is 1.25x, calculated as NOI divided by scheduled debt service.
Interest-only debt service of £60,000 annually plus an £800,000 balloon remains a comparison control, not the selected repayment basis.
Scenario probabilities are pre-tax and exclude FX, unpriced acquisition expenses, legal outcomes, and exit costs.

nodes.title: Client requests a five-flat cross-border structure
nodes.detail: The client seeks advice on acquiring five English flats and prefers a Liechtenstein fund while demanding an undefined 10% annual return.

runtime.pressure: A reservation and financing timetable is approaching while key tax, funding, and regulatory facts remain unverified.

nodes.title: PRC-resident, non-UK-resident client
nodes.detail: Residence, UBO identity, wealth, funds location, lawful outbound route, and purchaser capacity require documentary evidence.

nodes.title: Five-flat acquisition and amortizing debt profile
nodes.detail: Price is £1,000,000 with £800,000 debt, £200,000 deposit, 7.5% rate, 120-month amortization, £146,000 corrected annual gross rent (owner-provided input; independent evidence pending), and a 1.25x lender DSCR threshold. The broker's separate £150,000 claim is unsupported. Owner-revised expenses under the 25% rule: 25% × £146,000 = £36,500 per year. Rent after these expenses, before financing and other costs: £146,000 − £36,500 = £109,500 per year.

nodes.title: Transaction and review milestones
nodes.detail: Preliminary view: Day 3; lender structure: Day 10; reservation: Day 15; exchange: Day 25; completion: Day 45; post-completion review: Day 365. No clock times were supplied.

runtime.pressure: Missed evidence or lender gates may require renegotiation or stopping rather than rushed formation.

nodes.title: Three-country legal and tax gates require verification
nodes.detail: Purchaser-specific UK tax and filings, PRC worldwide tax and lawful outbound funding, and Liechtenstein AIF eligibility, regulation, substance, transparency, treaty, and distribution treatment must be documented. Formation alone creates no treaty access.

nodes.title: Set the scope of the engagement
nodes.detail: Choose whether to test the requested fund against lawful alternatives or initially limit work to the requested structure, subject to professional independence.

runtime.pressure: The client prefers immediate fund formation.

nodes.title: Define the 10% return metric
nodes.detail: Require a named metric and present gross yield, NOI yield, after-tax cash-on-cash return, and 10-year after-tax equity IRR separately.

nodes.title: Obtain residence, UBO, wealth and funds evidence
nodes.detail: Decide whether the file supports lawful ownership and funding or whether advice must pause pending satisfactory evidence.

runtime.pressure: Unverified funds cannot be cured by nominees, false purpose, quota pooling, or informal transfer channels.

nodes.title: Commission asset, rent, title and lender diligence
nodes.detail: Test title, five-dwelling status, licensing and landlord obligations, achievable rent, operating costs, amortization, security, and borrower conditions.

runtime.pressure: The appraisal and title work each consume part of the pre-exchange timetable.

nodes.title: Decide whether to reserve the property
nodes.detail: Choose whether to reserve conditionally, renegotiate timing or economics, or avoid commitment while material evidence remains outstanding.

runtime.pressure: Reservation precedes exchange and completion milestones.

nodes.title: Obtain coordinated UK, PRC and Liechtenstein opinions
nodes.detail: Commission current, source-supported advice addressing tax, filings, outbound funds, AIF availability, transparency, treaty access, substance, leverage, and distributions.

runtime.pressure: Specialist work must fit the transaction calendar and £45,000 advisory budget.

nodes.title: Accept or reject the proposed funding route
nodes.detail: Proceed only with documented wealth and a lawful bank or SAFE-compliant route; unresolved or misdescribed funds require a pause or refusal.

runtime.pressure: The acquisition cannot lawfully proceed on concealed ownership or false transfer purposes.

nodes.title: Compare ownership and financing routes
nodes.detail: Compare direct individual ownership, a UK property SPV, an available Liechtenstein AIF, and an AIF holding a UK SPV, together with stopping or renegotiating.

nodes.title: Test the Liechtenstein AIF evidence package
nodes.detail: Require an FMA-authorised AIFM letter covering eligibility, approval, providers, leverage, legal form, substance, AML, UBO, CRS, tax transparency, treaty and PPT analysis, lender security, PRC distributions, timing, and complete fees.

runtime.pressure: The quoted setup and administration fees may omit mandatory providers or other material costs.

nodes.title: Complete purchaser-specific tax and cash-flow modeling
nodes.detail: Calculate SDLT only after purchaser, title, residence, and relief facts are known. Reconcile NOI, amortizing debt, DSCR, country taxes, distributions, full initial equity, returns, break-even points, exit, FX, and fund payback.

runtime.pressure: Returns are invalid if acquisition costs, setup fees, annual administration, or full initial cash are omitted.

nodes.title: Recommend, renegotiate, condition or decline execution
nodes.detail: Set conditions for KYC, lawful funds, lender approval, regulatory feasibility, tax filings, transaction documents, and a reconciled base, downside and evidenced-upside model.

runtime.pressure: Exchange and completion should not convert unresolved assumptions into asserted facts.

nodes.title: Review year-one results and compliance
nodes.detail: Compare actual rent, vacancy, repairs, DSCR, loan balance, taxes, ATED return position, distributions, fees, and FX against the approved model and covenant conditions.

runtime.pressure: Operational underperformance or filing failures may require remediation, refinancing, or exit planning.

nodes.title: Proportionate, evidenced and financially reconciled route
nodes.detail: The chosen route is supported by lawful funds, purchaser-specific tax analysis, lender approval, full-cost return metrics, complete filings, and evidence appropriate to its complexity. This may be a simple route rather than a fund.

nodes.title: Timely stop or renegotiation protects the client
nodes.detail: The adviser pauses, renegotiates, or declines because evidence, funding, financing, economics, timing, or legal feasibility is unresolved. The decision preserves compliance and avoids unsupported execution.

nodes.title: Lawful but uneconomic or materially defective execution
nodes.detail: The route suffers a financing or DSCR mismatch, unsupported treaty position, purchaser-tax error, compliance failure, excessive fund costs, trapped distributions, or operational underperformance. Concealed ownership or unlawful funding is a failure condition.

nodes.title: Annual rental income
nodes.detail: Annual gross rental income: £146,000 per year. Source status: Owner-revised assumption. Expenses under the 25% rule: 25% × £146,000 = £36,500 per year. Rent after these expenses, before financing and other costs: £146,000 − £36,500 = £109,500 per year. The retained £10,000 annual structure cost reduces model NOI to £99,500. Selected amortizing debt service of £113,953.70 leaves negative annual cash flow of −£14,453.70 before tax and unknown costs. Independent rent/budget evidence and outcome approval remain pending.

nodes.title: Client KYC profile
nodes.detail: Client should provide a completed KYC questionnaire

nodes.title: UK real estate object
nodes.detail: 1 mGBP 5 apartment rental units

rule.label: Open the client file
rule.detail: Record the stated residence and investment objective without treating identity, residence, wealth, or funding as verified.
rule.result: The client profile becomes the first evidence gate.

rule.label: Record the proposed transaction
rule.detail: Capture the five-flat asset, price, deposit, debt and rental facts as scenario inputs.
rule.result: The asset and financing file is available for testing.

rule.label: Map the transaction calendar
rule.detail: Place the supplied advice, lender, reservation, exchange, completion and review milestones on the file.
rule.result: Time pressure is visible without inventing clock times.

rule.label: Identify cross-border gates
rule.detail: Separate the UK, PRC and Liechtenstein questions that require specialist evidence.
rule.result: Formation and completion are made conditional on legal and evidential feasibility.

rule.label: Present the engagement choices
rule.detail: Explain the difference between implementing the preferred vehicle and conducting an independent comparative review.
rule.result: The player must define a defensible mandate.

rule.label: Authorize a comparative review
rule.detail: Test the requested fund against direct ownership, a UK SPV, an AIF holding a UK SPV, and stopping or renegotiating.
rule.result: The return target must be defined before structures are ranked.

rule.label: Start with a narrow fund mandate
rule.detail: Preserve professional independence and make any implementation subject to identity, funds and feasibility evidence.
rule.result: The review advances, but the economic metric remains unresolved for later modeling.

rule.label: Name and document the return metric
rule.detail: Select a metric while retaining all four required measures in the final comparison.
rule.result: The 10% target can be tested without conflating yield, cash flow and IRR.

rule.label: Pause over an undefined target
rule.detail: Decline to state that the target is met until the client identifies the intended measure.
rule.result: The engagement pauses without issuing a misleading return conclusion.

rule.label: Accept satisfactory preliminary evidence
rule.detail: Proceed after obtaining credible residence, UBO, wealth, funds-location and lawful-transfer materials.
rule.result: Asset and lender diligence may begin, subject to specialist confirmation.

rule.label: Stop for unresolved ownership or funds
rule.detail: Pause or decline where beneficial ownership, wealth, source of funds or transfer purpose cannot be supported.
rule.result: The transaction is not facilitated on an unsafe evidential basis.

rule.label: Commission title, licensing and valuation work
rule.detail: Order the £4,000 title and licensing review and £3,500 valuation and rent review; seek the £1,500 lender confirmation.
rule.result: Reservation can be considered using a stronger property and debt record.

rule.label: Defer reservation while specialists investigate
rule.detail: Avoid immediate reservation and direct the available time toward the legal and tax gates.
rule.result: Property evidence remains incomplete, but specialist feasibility work proceeds.

rule.label: Reserve subject to documented conditions
rule.detail: Use conditions addressing title, licensing, lender approval, lawful funds, tax analysis and structural feasibility.
rule.result: The transaction remains live without treating unresolved conditions as satisfied.

rule.label: Decline or renegotiate the reservation
rule.detail: Seek more time, different economics or withdrawal where the current timetable cannot support reliable advice.
rule.result: Premature commitment is avoided.

rule.label: Commission coordinated specialist opinions
rule.detail: Obtain UK tax work for £7,500, PRC and SAFE work for £6,000, and the AIFM letter for £4,500.
rule.result: The file receives jurisdiction-specific analysis and identified confirmation requirements.

rule.label: Pause when specialist coverage is unavailable
rule.detail: Do not substitute promoter assertions or assumptions for necessary jurisdictional analysis.
rule.result: The structure is not advanced without adequate professional coverage.

rule.label: Confirm a lawful funding route
rule.detail: Document ownership, wealth, source and movement of equity through lawful banking and applicable outbound procedures.
rule.result: The ownership routes can be compared on a compliant funding premise.

rule.label: Reject unsupported funding alternatives
rule.detail: Refuse quota pooling, false purpose, hidden nominees, underground banking or other unsupported routes.
rule.result: The matter stops or waits for a lawful alternative.

rule.label: Continue testing an AIF-based route
rule.detail: Test both a Liechtenstein AIF and an AIF holding a UK SPV without assuming availability or treaty access.
rule.result: The fund route proceeds to regulatory and economic proof.

rule.label: Model direct and UK SPV routes
rule.detail: Advance the simpler lawful baselines for purchaser-specific tax, financing and return comparison.
rule.result: The baseline routes proceed without unnecessary fund assumptions.

rule.label: Stop or renegotiate before structuring
rule.detail: Use this option where no route presently meets the legal, evidential, financing or economic constraints.
rule.result: A proportionate stop remains available as a positive advisory result.

rule.label: Accept a complete AIFM evidence package
rule.detail: Carry the evidenced regulatory form, providers, leverage, substance, transparency, treaty, lender, distribution and fee facts into the model.
rule.result: The fund can be compared without presuming legal or economic superiority.

rule.label: Proceed despite missing fund proof
rule.detail: Advance the vehicle without complete eligibility, provider, substance, treaty, financing or fee evidence.
rule.result: The route is exposed to treaty-shopping failure, financing defects, hidden costs or regulatory infeasibility.

rule.label: Reject an unsupported or uneconomic fund
rule.detail: Use the missing evidence or unfavorable cost-benefit result to stop the fund route while preserving simpler alternatives for a later mandate.
rule.result: Unsupported complexity is not implemented.

rule.label: Build the full-cost comparison model
rule.detail: Spend £2,500 to reconcile gross rent, 25% operating-cost assumption, NOI, amortizing debt, DSCR, taxes, distributions, full initial cash, four return metrics, fund benefit, payback, exit and FX.
rule.result: Execution choices rest on a model that identifies assumptions and does not use only the deposit as equity.

rule.label: Pause for irreconcilable tax or model inputs
rule.detail: Do not calculate purchaser tax or claim the target is met while purchaser identity, title treatment, residence, costs or return metric remains unresolved.
rule.result: The recommendation is withheld until the model can be reconciled.

rule.label: Execute subject to closing conditions
rule.detail: Proceed with the selected route only after KYC, funds, lender, tax, regulatory, filing and document conditions are satisfied; count the £15,000 setup fee once.
rule.result: The completed transaction moves to monitored year-one performance.

rule.label: Decline or renegotiate execution
rule.detail: Stop, change debt, seek a lower price, extend timing or select a simpler route where DSCR, costs, evidence or compliance conditions fail.
rule.result: The adviser avoids forcing completion on defective terms.

rule.label: Complete with unresolved conditions
rule.detail: Proceed despite an unproven tax position, financing mismatch, incomplete filings, unsupported treaty access or omitted costs.
rule.result: Execution creates material compliance, financing or economic exposure.

rule.label: Reconcile and remediate year-one performance
rule.detail: Complete required filings, compare actual results with the model, preserve covenant compliance, and address variances transparently. Include the £10,000 annual structure cost where applicable.
rule.result: The route remains proportionate, evidenced and monitored.

rule.label: Ignore material year-one variances
rule.detail: Fail to address vacancy, repairs, covenant pressure, filing obligations, distribution restrictions, fees or divergence from the approved return model.
rule.result: Operational underperformance or compliance defects impair the transaction.

rule.label: Renegotiate, refinance or plan an orderly exit
rule.detail: Respond to a sustained mismatch by changing debt or operations, or by planning a compliant exit rather than preserving an unsuitable structure.
rule.result: A controlled corrective decision limits further exposure.
